diaspora_bullets: The ruling will define how far a president's border-emergency powers reach over the asylum process

news_summary: The Supreme Court agreed on November 13 to hear Mullin v. RAICES, the challenge to President Trump's proclamation barring asylum claims by people who cross the southern border outside ports of entry.
payoff: Arguments are expected in spring 2027, with a decision anticipated by the end of June or early July 2027.
